name: mathlib_benchmark_v15
description: mathlib_benchmark_v15 is a dataset of formalized mathematical statements and associated proofs drawn from the Lean mathlib library, intended to evaluate automated theorem proving, premise selection, and proof synthesis systems. It measures a system's ability to generate correct formal proofs or to select useful premises within the Lean proof assistant environment. The benchmark is used to assess both proof success rates and the quality of generated proof scripts in an interactive proof assistant setting.
evaluation_method: proof_success_rate / exact_match of proof script or verification-success in Lean
reputation: mathlib-based benchmarks are well-regarded in the formal-methods and theorem-proving communities and are commonly used for evaluating proof automation progress.
